mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_session SET status=#{status}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), archived_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='ARCHIVED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END, deleted_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='DELETED' THEN COALESCE(deleted_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ELSE NULL END WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_run_state WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND status IN ('CREATED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL','RESUMING'))
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run_state SET status='CANCELLED', termination_reason='CANCELLED', error_summary='所属会话已删除', lease_owner=NULL, lease_until=NULL, completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version=version+1 WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND status IN ('CREATED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL','RESUMING')

UPDATE agent_tool_approval SET decision_status=CASE WHEN decision_status='PENDING' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE decision_status END, execution_status='CANCELLED', execution_completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), version=version+1 WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM agent_run_state WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}) AND execution_status IN ('WAITING_DECISION','READY','RUNNING')

UPDATE memory_extraction_task SET status='CANCELLED', payload=NULL, lease_owner=NULL, lease_until=NULL, last_error='source-session-deleted', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND (status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','RUNNING') OR payload IS NOT NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM conversation_session WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND status='DELETED' AND deleted_at < TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, -#{retentionDays}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM conversation_message WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE FROM memory_extraction_task WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE FROM agent_tool_approval WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM agent_run_state WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}) LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE FROM agent_run_event WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM agent_run_state WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}) LIMIT #{limit}

DELETE FROM agent_run_submission WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM agent_run_state WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_run_event e WHERE e.run_id=agent_run_submission.run_id) LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE FROM agent_execution_trace WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE FROM memory_entry WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND tier='SHORT_TERM' LIMIT #{limit}

DELETE FROM conversation_session WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND status='DELETED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversation_message WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_extraction_task WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_run_state WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_execution_trace WHERE session_id=#{sessionId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_entry WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND tier='SHORT_TERM')
